relations.text: AvePointは、Google Cloud Platformなどのマーケットプレイスを通じてSaaS製品を提供している
relations.text_en: AvePoint offers its SaaS products via the Google Cloud Platform marketplace, among others

source.label: AvePoint 10-K
source.quote: We also offer our SaaS products via the marketplaces of our technology alliance partners, including Google Cloud Platform (" GCP "), Microsoft Azure, (" Azure ") and Amazon Web Services (" AWS ").

relations.text: AvePointは、Microsoft、Google、AWSと技術・販売・マーケティングの戦略的提携を結んでいる
relations.text_en: AvePoint maintains strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Google and AWS covering technology, sales and marketing

source.label: AvePoint 10-K
source.quote: We maintain strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Google, and AWS that incorporate technology, sales, and marketing initiatives.

relations.text: AvePointのConfidence Platformは、Google GCPの仮想マシンのデータ保護にも対応した
relations.text_en: The AvePoint Confidence Platform now supports data protection for Google GCP Virtual Machines

source.label: AvePoint の発表
source.quote: The Confidence Platform also now supports data protection for Google GCP Virtual Machines, bringing secure and flexible backup technology to more infrastructure sources and further supporting multi-cloud customers.

relations.text: AvePointは、Microsoftとの20年にわたる提携の節目として、Microsoft 365 Backupとの連携を発表した
relations.text_en: AvePoint announced integration with Microsoft 365 Backup as the latest milestone in its 20-year partnership with Microsoft

source.label: AvePoint の発表
source.quote: AvePoint (NASDAQ: AVPT), the global leader in data security, governance, and resilience, today announced the evolution of its Cloud Backup offering and the latest milestone in its 20-year partnership with Microsoft, working with them to integrate with Microsoft 365 Backup

relations.text: AvePointのConfidence Platformは、monday.comのデータバックアップと保護に対応している
relations.text_en: The AvePoint Confidence Platform provides automated data backup and protection for Monday.com

source.label: AvePoint の発表
source.quote: The expansion of AvePoint’s already comprehensive data protection capabilities means that the AvePoint Confidence Platform now provides automated data backup and protection for business-critical applications Monday.com, Docusign, Smartsheet, Okta and Confluence.
source.note: 製品の対応範囲としての記載です。
